h1: The 4 Best Auto-Empty Cordless Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: four cordless stick vacuums with auto-empty systems, compared on listed run time, price range and what each dock adds.
summary: The Shark PowerDetect Clean & Empty lists 70 minutes of run time, the most here. The Shark PowerDetect Reveal offers the same run time in a lower price range, the Shark Clean & Empty is the shorter 40 minute option, and the ILIFE is the pet-focused alternative.
intro: The point of an auto-empty dock is that you stop touching dust, but the dock itself takes space and the listing rarely says how long the bag lasts. Run time and price range are the numbers you can actually compare.

We ranked four cordless stick vacuums that include an auto-empty system, using the run time and price range each listing states. Several cordless models in the same category lack a dock and were left out. We did not test suction.

products.name: Shark PowerDetect Clean & Empty Cordless Stick Vacuum
products.verdict: 70 minutes of listed run time with an auto-empty dock.
products.description:
The Shark PowerDetect Clean & Empty is a cordless stick vacuum with an auto-empty system and 70 minutes of listed run time. It is priced from $200 to $500.

It leads because it matches the longest run time here and comes from an established vacuum brand. The cheaper Reveal model shares the 70 minutes, so you are paying for what the PowerDetect version adds.

Best for larger homes where run time matters. Check the listing for what PowerDetect detects.
products.idealFor: Larger homes needing long run time.

products.name: Shark PowerDetect Reveal Clean & Empty Cordless Stick Vacuum &
products.verdict: The same 70 minute run time in a lower price range.
products.description:
The Shark PowerDetect Reveal Clean & Empty lists 70 minutes of run time and an auto-empty system, in the $100 to $200 range.

It takes second place because it matches the PowerDetect on run time at a lower price. The listing name is truncated, so confirm the exact bundle on the page.

Best for buyers who want Shark's dock without the higher price. Verify the model on the listing.

products.name: ILIFE Cordless Stick Vacuum Cleaner with Auto-Empty System for Pet
products.verdict: A pet-targeted stick vacuum with a dock and 45 minutes of run time.
products.description:
The ILIFE is a cordless stick vacuum with an auto-empty system, marketed for pets, with 45 minutes of listed run time in the $100 to $200 range.

Third place reflects a shorter run time than the Sharks above, though it is a lesser-known brand.

Choose it for a smaller pet home. Check the dock bag capacity before ordering.
products.skipIf: You need over an hour of run time.

products.name: Shark Clean & Empty Cordless Stick Vacuum & Auto-Empty System
products.verdict: The shortest run time here at 40 minutes, from a known brand.
products.description:
The Shark Clean & Empty lists 40 minutes of run time with an auto-empty system, in the $200 to $500 range.

Fourth place reflects the shortest run time here at a price that overlaps the longer-running PowerDetect.

Best for apartments or small homes where 40 minutes is enough.

whatMatters.detail: Run time is how long the battery lasts per charge. Listings here claim 40 to 70 minutes, usually on the lowest power mode. Check the figure in the specs.
The auto-empty dock sits on the floor or wall and needs space and an outlet. Measure before buying. The dock also holds the dust bag.
Auto-empty docks use bags that need replacing. Check what bags cost and how many are included.
Pet-targeted models usually add tools for hair. Check which attachments come in the box.
Prices here run from $100 to $500. Compare run time per dollar.

faq.a: The dock pulls dust from the vacuum into a bag so you do not touch it. The bag still needs replacing.
Ignoring dock size. The dock needs floor or wall space near an outlet.

faq.q: Is the PowerDetect worth it over the Reveal?
faq.a: Both list 70 minutes. The Reveal costs less, so check what the PowerDetect adds.

faq.q: How long is 70 minutes in practice?
faq.a: Listed run time is usually on the lowest power mode, so expect less on higher settings.

faq.q: How do I maintain the dock?
faq.a: Replace the bag as needed and clear the intake. Check the listing for bag type.

faq.q: Do other cordless vacuums have docks?
faq.a: Only some. We left out models that did not name an auto-empty system.

finalTake: The Shark PowerDetect Clean & Empty is the safest all-round auto-empty pick with 70 minutes. The PowerDetect Reveal gives the same run time for less. For pets or small homes, the ILIFE or the basic Shark are workable.
